name: DwgCommandSet
description: DWG import/link interrogation toolkit for Revit: extract curve geometry from imported or linked DWG files

commands.description: Extract curve geometry (layer, type, endpoints, arc/ellipse parameters, tessellated polyline) from an imported or linked DWG. Omit dwgNameOrId to list available DWGs.
Draw one DWG layer's curves as Revit model lines (lines, 3-point arcs, or tessellated polylines) on a sketch plane at the layer's median elevation.
